authorProcess: Claude Code session (STEP 12) — rule fixed before any candidate cohort is enumerated or computed
purpose: Choose follow-up drifter cohorts by observation-only, pre-defined numeric criteria so that no model result can influence which cohort is used.

observationSource.provider: NOAA AOML GDP hourly QC (ERDDAP drifter_hourly_qc, CC BY 4.0)
observationSource.note: same product and access path as the 2015-01 cohorts

candidateRegions.definedBefore: any data query for the follow-up
candidateRegions.rationale: Boxes are standard western-boundary/extension regions taken from textbook geography, restricted to 40S–40N because the HYCOM GLBv0.08 latitude spacing changes from 0.08° to 0.04° poleward of 40° and the current reader only accepts uniform spacing.

candidateWindows.reason: keep the HYCOM expt_53.X 2015 archive already used; no cross-year archive mixing
candidateWindows.enumeration: every day of 2015 at 12:00Z, per region

advectionDominantDefinition.principle: Observation-only quantities; no model output enters the definition.

A1_observedSpeedAtStart.quantity: median over cohort drifters of hypot(ve, vn) at the window start sample (GDP provider velocity, m/s)

A2_observed72hDisplacement.quantity: median over cohort drifters of haversine distance between the start sample and the +72 h sample
A2_observed72hDisplacement.rationale: about twice the 2015-01 quiet-gyre stationary error (19.2 km); guarantees the stationary baseline is not trivially strong

A3_persistenceOfDirection.quantity: median over cohort of |bearing(0→24 h) − bearing(24→72 h)|
A3_persistenceOfDirection.rationale: excludes purely inertial/tidal looping windows where displacement is large but not advective

eligibilityPerDrifter.E1: drogue_lost_date empty or later than window end (provider field)
eligibilityPerDrifter.E3: all 73 hourly samples present in the window; no provider gap > 3600 s
eligibilityPerDrifter.E4: start position at least 100 km from the nearest coastline (Natural Earth 1:10m) — the forcing has no coastline geometry
eligibilityPerDrifter.E5: start position inside the region box; drifters that leave the box during the window are NOT excluded (that would be result-based)

cohortEligibility.C_n: at least 20 eligible drifters in the window across the selected regions and at least 8 in each selected region
cohortEligibility.C_forcing: HYCOM expt_53.X 15 m coverage for the box + 1° margin and the window must be obtainable (archive gaps reject the window); NCEP-R2 10 m wind coverage likewise

selectionProcedure: 1. For each region, enumerate all 2015 windows (day at 12Z) and count eligible drifters (E1–E5) using observation data only.
2. Keep windows satisfying C_n (per-region minimum 8) and compute A1–A3 from observations only.
4. Within each region choose the EARLIEST calendar window that survives steps 1–3. Calendar order is the only tie-breaker; no model output, no wind statistics, no V1/V2 knowledge is consulted.
5. Take the two regions with the largest eligible count at their chosen window; if fewer than two regions qualify, record BLOCKED_COHORT and do not relax thresholds.
6. Freeze the chosen windows, drifter IDs and all A/E/C values in cohort-step12.json and commit it BEFORE any forcing download or model run.

exclusionRules.X1: No window may be chosen or rejected because of any model result (V1, V2, HYCOM, GLORYS).
exclusionRules.X2: Thresholds A1–A3, E1–E5, C_n are not adjusted after any data are seen; a change requires a new ruleId and a new commit before use.
exclusionRules.X3: A cohort that fails C_forcing is BLOCKED, not replaced by a neighbouring window chosen for convenience.
exclusionRules.X4: Drifters are never dropped after the run for being 'outliers'.

leakageStatement: The 2015-01 quiet-gyre cohort (A/B) is excluded from candidate windows (regions differ). No follow-up run may reuse the 2015-01 cohort under this rule.
